semiconductor_relevance: High — Bossmen Inc. specializes in humidity control systems that are critical for preventing moisture damage in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Bossmen Inc. provides advanced humidity control systems designed to maintain optimal conditions for semiconductor components, including ICs and PCBs. Their solutions are tailored to meet industry standards, ensuring reliability and yield improvement in semiconductor production environments.
capabilities: Custom designs for ABF films and PCBs
Humidity data logging and monitoring systems

regional_presence.Taiwan: Bossmen Inc. was founded in Taipei and has a manufacturing facility in Yangmei, Taoyuan.
